fixes: Keep Check for updates and the installed version visible before and after sign-in.
Show checking, up-to-date, update-available and failed-check states; show Install update when a newer version is available.
Retry failed checks after one minute and offer the official installer download instead of silently waiting six hours.
Prevent duplicate checks and overlapping update/integration installations; restore retry controls after failed installation.
Preserve compact release notes and the full changelog link.

tests.source_gui: Real HTTPS check against the then-current 1.3.11 public feed with an isolated older-version fixture showed Install update. A simulated subsequent check failure showed retry/download controls. Screenshots inspected for readability and visibility.
tests.signed_gui: Launched the signed 1.3.12 app with an isolated HOME and no account credentials. Check for updates was visible before sign-in, reported installed version 1.3.12 and remained visible after a native click completed the check. Screenshots inspected; test app then quit.
tests.installer: Apple notarization accepted and stapled. Signed binary passed fresh/repeat integration setup, real four-stem separation and HTTPS/WebSocket TLS checks. Isolated updater with local DMG transport rejected a bad checksum, retained the previous app and passed fresh-copy signature/Gatekeeper checks.
tests.browser_deployed: Public login/signup/password-reset/guide/changelog returned 200 at 1440px and 390px. Invalid sign-in returned readable validation; protected dashboard redirected to login. No page errors, broken Next.js assets or horizontal overflow observed.
tests.production_health: ECS stable with one task; API healthy with Bedrock configured. Protected routes returned 401 without authentication.
